platformNotes.facebook: Organic wildlife posts are non-commercial by default and must not carry Safari or Selar links. A campaign destination may appear only in a separate post whose exact campaign is active, owner-approved, disclosure-approved and allowlisted. Never dump every destination into one caption.
platformNotes.instagram: Organic wildlife posts are non-commercial by default. Do not put Safari or Selar campaign links in captions, bio or Story stickers unless the exact campaign has been approved for this brand and the campaign-specific disclosure is visible.
platformNotes.youtube: Nature Frontiers channel only; do not use SonicVhibez as the destination. The channel subscription URL is optional and is not required on every post.

notes: This file is a destination catalogue, not a requirement to include every URL in every post.
Organic wildlife education is non-commercial by default: campaignId=null, commercial=false, disclosureRequired=false, publishingEnabled=false, dryRun=true and emergencyStop=true.
Safari affiliate destinations remain INACTIVE until exact destination URLs, owner approval and affiliate disclosure approval are recorded in the campaign registry.
Selar is ACTIVE_FOR_DRAFTS_ONLY; its direct-sales disclosure remains PENDING_OWNER_APPROVAL for public use and must never be described as an affiliate commission.
A single post may not mix Safari affiliate and Selar direct-sales destinations.
Never copy a destination, disclosure, compensation type, price, offer or tracking parameter from one campaign type into another.
